name: playsole-one
description: Unified identity and account platform (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect) for the Playsole ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/shared && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/auth && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/session && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/profile && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/consent && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/security && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/gateway && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/server && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/worker && npm run build --workspace=@playsole-one/mcp
scripts.dev:multi: concurrently -n session,auth,profile,consent,security,gateway -c cyan,magenta,green,blue,yellow,red "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=services/session/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs services/session/src/index.ts" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=services/auth/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs services/auth/src/index.ts" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=services/profile/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs services/profile/src/index.ts" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=services/consent/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs services/consent/src/index.ts" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=services/security/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs services/security/src/index.ts" "node --watch --watch-preserve-output --watch-path=gateway/src --watch-path=packages/shared/src --env-file=.env -r tsx/cjs gateway/src/index.ts"
